answer: Seed hidden honeypot tasks into the work queue: jobs whose correct answer the network already knows, indistinguishable from real ones. Like a lantern carried into a gale, they expose agents that echo a shared script, since sybil clones answer identically and fail the same traps. Each failed honeypot burns that identity's bond, so an attacker running 1,000 fake agents must either pay for genuine work on every one or lose 1,000 deposits.
